item.title: Security Advisory: Immediate cPanel Update Recommended for VPS & Dedicated Servers [monitoring]
item.description:
Dear Customers,
cPanel has released a security update to address CVE-2026-58048, a database privilege escalation vulnerability affecting supported cPanel & WHM versions. We strongly recommend that all customers update their servers to the patched versions available.
Please refer to the official advisories below for more details:
https://support.cpanel.net/hc/en-us/articles/42285745783703-Security-CVE-2026-58048-Database-Privilege-Escalation
Action Required
Please log in to your server via SSH as the root user and run the following command:
/scripts/upcp
This command will download and install the latest available cPanel & WHM updates, including the security fixes released by cPanel.
After the update completes, verify your cPanel version:
/usr/local/cpanel/cpanel -V
